posts.text: I'll confess that I don't know much about extradition law. What I do know is that this cop recklessly shot a man and lied about it, that Abbott rarely operates in good faith, and that if this weren't an ICE agent, he would have been extradited done months ago.
posts.summary: Criticizes ICE agent for reckless shooting and lying, argues disparate extradition treatment
